sources.title: GitHub - Plachtaa/seed-vc: zero-shot voice conversion & singing voice ...
sources.snippet: Seed-VC English | 简体中文 | 日本語 real-time-demo.webm Currently released model supports zero-shot voice conversion 🔊 , zero-shot real-time voice conversion 🗣️ and zero-shot singing voice conversion 🎶. Without any training, it is able to clone a voice given a reference speech of 1~30 seconds.

sources.title: Seed-VC - plachtaa.github.io
sources.snippet: Seed-VC is named after Seed-TTS as the method and training scheme is inspired by the paper's description about voice conversion. We may change name based on future development of this project. This page is for showing results and comparisons only. The examples of other VC models are directly retrieved from their demo pages.
